entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: unknown scalar comparison projection boundary %d
entries.rationale: This boundary is an internal projection-layout invariant, not a query-language rejection. lowerComparisonOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp always supplies scalarComparisonCanonical and lowerVectorScalar always supplies scalarComparisonGuarded to finishScalarComparison. No parser expression, request, or user configuration supplies the boundary value. The unknown-boundary test uses a nil input to verify rejection precedes role resolution.
